body_lead: The Karnataka government on Friday launched KEO (Knowledge-driven, Economical and Open-source) an AI ready computing device. KEO was developed through a collaboration between the Department of Electronics, IT and Biotechnology, Government of Karnataka, KEONICS, semiconductor partners and AI-focused system integrators. It brings together an open-source RISC-V processor architecture, open-source hardware and software, and on-device artificial intelligence in a compact desktop platform.
